comment: ChainMixerAux.cpp:36-39 calls configParam(ParamSolo1, ...) twice and configParam(ParamMute1, ...) twice, never ParamSolo2 or ParamMute2. Two consequences, both visible in the installed build's census: the AUX 1 solo and mute buttons carry the names Solo AUX 2 and Mute AUX 2, and the AUX 2 solo and mute buttons have no ParamQuantity at all, so Rack's ParamWidget refuses to drag them and they stay at zero. The maker's manual describes AUX 2 solo and mute as working.
